title: Norwegian Rose Petal Tart with Custard
description: A unique dessert that combines the flavors of Norway and Thailand, featuring a floral and delicate rose petal tart topped with a creamy custard.
instructions: Roll out the floral pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place the dough circles into the tart shells.
In a bowl, mix together the rose petals, Norwegian cream, granulated sugar, eggs, and custard powder.
Pour the mixture into the tart shells.
Drizzle the melted butter over the filling.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.
